messages:
maria (marketing): hey team — final coordination for tomorrow's publish. need: changelog link for the external post, docs anchor URLs, exact rollout window, and who'll join the webinar panel.
aj (eng): changelog is live in the internal repo: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/release-notes/3.2 — public-friendly summary is at /docs/release-notes/3.2 (elaine will confirm anchor).
elaine (docs): confirming — the public anchors: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes#v3-2 and https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/quantization (will add a short "what's changed" blurb by EOD).
sam (product): timeline: plan to cut the announcement at 11:00 PT, allow 30m for CDN propagation, then enable marketing pages + benchmarks. can we keep canary on for 1 hour? want to capture perf telemetry.
aj (eng): canary OK. schedule: canary @ 11:00 PT (10% of traffic), full rollout @ 12:00 PT if no regressions. we'll stream perf metrics to the dashboard.
ben (growth): inbound routing: route trial signups to SDR queue "SDR-Launch" in SFDC. can we add a webhook payload so we get UTM + model selection? our ops will convert to leads instantly.
aj (eng): yes — endpoint: https://hooks.redwood.ai/marketing/inbound-launch. payload will include utm_campaign, model, plan. need list of required fields from you.
ben (growth): perfect — I'll DM the required field list. also: can we add a small post-signup survey to capture use-case? 1 question max.
elaine (docs): for the external post, suggest a short benchmark callout + link to a deeper benchmark appendix. I'll draft the copy: 2 bullets + CTA to benchmarks and migration guide.
maria (marketing): webinar: 3 speakers (aj for tech, sam for product, case study lead TBD). preferred time: same day @ 16:00 PT to catch EMEA and US west. objections?
sam (product): that's fine. can we record and clip highlights for socials? ops will need slide deck and demo script by morning.
aj (eng): I'll do a 10-minute kernel/quantization explainer and live perf Q&A. need the exact prompt sets we'll demo.
maria (marketing): I'll push the deck template to the shared folder and tag you — https://drive.google.com/launch/webinar-deck (brand assets included).
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: canary rollout started 11:00 PT — job id dpl_20240323_0910.
aj (eng): quick note: if we see token-latency spike > 2x baseline in canary, we rollback to v3.1. rollback window set to 11:50 PT.
ben (growth): for lead scoring, mark signups from webinar as "high" and route to SDR-Launch with tag webinar=mar23.
elaine (docs): added the migration checklist to /docs/migration#3-2, short diff and recommended flags. link: https://docs.redwood.ai/migration#3-2.
maria (marketing): final asks: everyone, confirm you have assets by 09:30 PT tomorrow; if not, call it out now. also need a 1-line embargo-safe summary for PR.
aj (eng): assets done from eng side (changelog + rollback playbook).
elaine (docs): docs blurb and anchors done by 09:15 PT.
sam (product): demo script in the deck by 09:30 PT.
ben (growth): lead routing webhook and SFDC mapping will be tested by 10:00 PT.
maria (marketing): thanks all — I'll post the embargoed PR + social schedule to this channel an hour before publish. :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary complete at 11:25 PT — metrics within expected range.
maria (marketing): great — keeping this thread open for any last-minute changes.
